postings.title: Sales Account Executive (Lausanne, Switzerland)
postings.text: We are currently seeking a highly motivated individual for a full-time role of Sales Account Executive. The Sales Account Executive will be responsible for growing revenues and managing customer accounts. This role is located in Epalinges (VD), Switzerland. You will be part of the Sales team reporting to the Co-Founder and CEO.

postings.title: Head of lab
postings.text: We are seeking an experienced and motivated Head of Lab to oversee operations in our new self-driving lab in Boston, which is poised to revolutionize the R&D landscape and set new standards. Focused on small molecule synthesis and polymorph screening, this cutting-edge lab will be fully automated and integrated with Atinary’s no-code AI platform, –SDLabs– to drive autonomous experimentation, allowing us to push the boundaries of chemical innovation.

postings.title: Full Stack Developer
postings.text: We are currently seeking a highly motivated individual for a full-time role of Full Stack Developer. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in developing and maintaining our AI-powered software suite, SDLabs. This role is based in Lausanne, Switzerland.

postings.title: Junior Office Manager (Lausanne, Switzerland)
postings.text: Are you looking for new challenges in an exciting high-growth company with a noble and impactful mission? Do you have strong organization and communication skills? Are you highly organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about numbers and accounting? Do you enjoy supporting teams and keeping things running smoothly? We’re looking for a  Junior Office Manager  to join us in Lausanne and support our mission to revolutionize science and R&D!

postings.title: Synthetic Chemist, Self-Driving Lab (Boston, MA)
postings.text: We are seeking an experienced and motivated Synthetic Chemist in our new self-driving lab in Boston, which is poised to revolutionize the R&D landscape and set new standards. Focused on small molecule synthesis, automation and artificial intelligence (machine learning) for chemistry, this cutting-edge lab will be fully automated and integrated with Atinary’s no-code AI platform –SDLabs– to drive autonomous experimentation, allowing us to push the boundaries of chemical innovation.

postings.title: Lead AI Scientist
postings.text: We are seeking an experienced Lead AI Scientist to work closely with our multi-disciplinary team to define and drive Atinary’s research agenda. While this is a leadership role for a scientist with a strong track record in machine learning—shaping strategy, guiding the team, and translating state-of-the-art methods into real-world impact—it is also a hands-on position. You will actively develop code, contribute to the core codebase, and advance algorithm development, in addition to mentoring colleagues, scaling our research group, and representing Atinary in the global ML community.

postings.title: DevOps
postings.text: Are you a passionate DevOps Engineer looking to make an impact in a dynamic and fast-paced environment? Then join Atinary Technologies (Lausanne, Switzerland) and its talented team to shape a future where AI is at the core of the R&D landscape! SDLabs, our main product, is an end-to-end software suite that uses machine learning to optimize processes and accelerate materials discovery.

postings.title: Machine Learning Engineer
postings.text: We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Lausanne, Switzerland. This pivotal role focuses on building and scaling the ML systems that power our AI-driven R&D platform, SDLabs. Join Atinary to shape a future where AI is central to scientific discovery, enabling researchers to accelerate innovation through our Self-Driving Labs™ technologies (SDLabs software and robotics integrations). We are looking for strong engineering foundations, a passion for machine learning, and the ability to solve complex problems proactively within our fast-paced, generalist team.

postings.title: Full Stack Developer (Lausanne, Switzerland)
postings.text: Are you a passionate Full Stack Developer ready to build the infrastructure for the next age of science? Join Atinary Technologies in Lausanne and help us transform R&D from isolated, manual experimentation into a continuous, compounding engine for discovery. Our core mission is to scale Self-Driving Labs®: a new standard for R&D that integrates AI, robotics, and cloud software into a single, continuously learning system. By removing the bottlenecks of human-driven process speeds, we enable scientists to achieve a year’s worth of experimental output in a single week.
